Free, open-source WhatsApp desktop app with message scheduling. Unofficial; not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.

## Download

| Your computer | File |
|---|---|
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 and later) | `WA-Premium-Plus-<version>-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac with Intel processor | `WA-Premium-Plus-<version>-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Windows 10 or 11 | `WA-Premium-Plus-<version>-windows-setup.exe` |
| Linux | `WA-Premium-Plus-<version>-linux-x86_64.AppImage` |

## First launch

The app isn't signed by Apple or Microsoft (that costs money every year), so your system asks you to confirm once:

- **macOS:** open the DMG and drag the app to Applications. Open it; when macOS says it can't verify the developer, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows:** if SmartScreen appears, click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Linux:** make the file executable (`chmod +x WA-Premium-Plus-*.AppImage`), then run it.

Then open **Linked devices → Link a device** in WhatsApp on your phone and scan the QR code.

See the [README](https://github.com/imbikramsaha/WA-Premium-Plus#readme) for features and known limitations.
